cleaner.label: PlatformIO cache
cleaner.description: PlatformIO cache and, as separate options, installed toolchains and platforms. Does not touch global libraries.

option.label: PlatformIO cache
option.description: Removes the registry requests and downloaded packages kept in the cache.

option.label: Installed packages (toolchains and SDKs)
option.description: Removes the toolchains, frameworks, SDKs and upload tools installed by PlatformIO.
option.warning: Toolchains are re-downloaded on the next build (`pio run`): network required.

option.label: Installed development platforms
option.description: Removes the development platforms installed by PlatformIO.
option.warning: Platforms are reinstalled on the next build (`pio run`) or with `pio pkg install`: network required.
